metadataRaw.title: Fix a High Shoulder in Seconds
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a simple exercise that may help fix a high shoulder—even in just 30 seconds!

A common cause of a high shoulder (or uneven shoulders) is muscle weakness. Over time, the muscles that lower and stabilize the shoulder can become weak, leading to imbalance.

This exercise targets and strengthens those muscles to help restore proper shoulder alignment and posture.

Let us know how it works for you!
